intended_object: The canonical isomorphism between the homology of a short complex S (when it has homology) and the object H of any right homology data h of S. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The definition composes two isomorphisms. The first is the inverse of `S.rightHomologyIso`, which goes from the homology to the right homology. The second is `h.rightHomologyIso`, which goes from the right homology to `h.H`. Composed, they give the canonical isomorphism `S.homology ≅ h.H`, which is what the docstring describes. The setting is the general one for short complexes: any category with zero morphisms, and any short complex that has homology. Nothing here should be generalized. I did not search for a separate Mathlib counterpart, because this file is itself part of Mathlib and this definition is the standard version of this isomorphism.
